argument: Chapter 6 fails its own voice-and-consistency bar, though the character work and the absence of draft residue are genuinely clean. (1) Over-saturation: the always-hit / one-roll claim is asserted four separate times inside the chapter (the opener teaser at :23, the Attack Rolls lead at :65, the damage-budget note at :73, and a callout at :77-79), and the defense-reversal idea is restated three times back to back (:122, :124, :132). (2) Stock-phrase reuse: Table 6.1 recycles the introduction chapter's tier copy, including the same closing image the intro already used at 01:94. (3) Rationale stacking: the chapter carries three separate design-rationale blocks (:43-47, :77-79, :126-132) where sibling ch13 instead cross-references ch06 for rationale; at least two should be cut or folded. (4) Term collision: 'Challenge' carries three senses with no disambiguation and no glossary entry for the penalty sense (:101 introduces it as a DA penalty, ch13 calls it a rating, ch20/ch21 define it as monster difficulty), and the chapter's own Difficulty Modifiers table (:205-226) shares the same -6..+4 range, so a reader cannot tell a Challenge from a Difficulty Modifier. The sign convention also flips between chapters (ch06 writes the penalty with a leading minus, ch16 writes the bare rating that is then subtracted), and ch06's goblin value contradicts the bestiary's challenge band; I leave the numeric reconciliation to the mechanics lens and flag only the naming/notation collision here. (5) Flavor balance: only one of the three callouts carries a rule consequence; the other two are pure design rationale, and the worked-example italics ('That's concerning.', 'The chieftain roars, he felt that one.') are decoration with no mechanical job. Character voice itself holds: Kael (Blade), Lyra (Odd), Roric (Protector) and Makeva keep their established class and stat fingerprints from ch01, ch02, ch03 and ch16, with one blemish, that the chapter renames the established Makeva Quickfoot using Lyra's class epithet. No prose draft residue (no TODO/TBD/'we might'/'in a future version'); the only placeholder is the book-wide art caption. Minimal edits recommended: cut the :77-79 rationale callout, fold :122-124 into :105-120, drop the :132 restatement, and add a one-line disambiguation of Challenge at :101 that links the glossary and separates it from a Difficulty Modifier.
